title: Confusion matrix with metrics
summary: How well a classifier sorts tweets into Environmental, Social and Governance topics — out-of-fold 3 × 3 confusion matrix with bootstrap intervals for the metrics.

title: Precision–recall curves
summary: Out-of-fold precision–recall curves for two classifiers predicting which Facebook users share COVID-19 fake news, with average precision and the no-skill baseline.

title: Learning curve
summary: Training and cross-validated accuracy as the training set grows, for two models predicting which Facebook users share COVID-19 fake news.

title: Cross-validated model comparison
summary: Fold-by-fold R² of six models predicting the waste rate of production batches, with means and corrected 95% intervals.

title: Permutation importance
summary: Which process features a random forest relies on to predict a batch's waste rate — drop in test-set R² when each one is shuffled.

title: Partial dependence with ICE curves
summary: How a batch's predicted waste rate changes with machine speed and with days since maintenance — the average (PDP) over one curve per batch (ICE).

title: SHAP summary (beeswarm)
summary: Every production batch's SHAP value for every process feature, coloured by the feature's value, with mean |SHAP| importance.

title: SHAP dependence plot
summary: How days since maintenance feed into each batch's predicted waste rate, coloured by its strongest interaction partner, with a smooth trend.

title: SHAP waterfall for one prediction
summary: How each process feature moves one high-waste batch's predicted waste rate from the average to the model's output.

title: Choropleth with spatial weights
summary: A map of one variable with the neighbour network drawn on top — the structure every spatial statistic relies on.

title: Moran scatterplot (global autocorrelation)
summary: Each area against the average of its neighbours, with Moran's I, its permutation test and the reference distribution.

title: LISA cluster map (local autocorrelation)
summary: Where the clusters and spatial outliers are — local Moran's I for each area, mapped with its permutation significance.

title: Spatial correlogram
summary: Moran's I at increasing neighbour orders, with a permutation envelope — how far spatial clustering reaches.

title: Histogram with density
summary: Histogram, kernel density and fitted normal curve, with shape statistics.

title: Raincloud plot
summary: Half violin, box plot and raw points per group, drawn horizontally.

title: Ridgeline plot
summary: Overlapping density curves to compare one distribution across many groups.

title: ECDF comparison
summary: Empirical cumulative distributions of two groups, with the Kolmogorov–Smirnov gap.

title: Q–Q plot with confidence band
summary: Normal quantile–quantile plots with a 95% envelope, for a raw and a logged variable.

title: Between-groups comparison
summary: Violin + box + points with Welch's ANOVA, effect size and pairwise tests.

title: Within-subjects comparison
summary: Repeated measures with one line per subject, means, rm-ANOVA and paired tests.

title: Estimation plot
summary: Raw data of two groups plus the mean difference and its bootstrap 95% CI.

title: Interaction plot
summary: Group means with 95% confidence intervals for two factors, with a two-way ANOVA.

title: Tukey HSD intervals
summary: Simultaneous 95% confidence intervals for every pairwise difference in means.

title: Diverging Likert chart
summary: Five-point Likert items as diverging stacked bars centred on the neutral answer.

title: Stacked proportions by group
summary: 100% stacked bars with percentage labels, n per bar, chi-squared test and Cramér's V.

title: Mosaic plot with Pearson residuals
summary: Tile areas proportional to cell counts, shaded by Pearson residuals from independence.

title: Proportions with confidence intervals
summary: A sorted dot plot of proportions with Wilson 95% confidence intervals.

title: Cross-table with standardized residuals
summary: A contingency table as a heatmap, coloured by standardized residuals from independence.

title: Correlation matrix
summary: Lower-triangle Pearson correlation heatmap; non-significant cells (Holm) are crossed out.

title: Scatterplot with statistics
summary: Trade intensity vs business-cycle correlation for country pairs — scatter, OLS line with 95% band, marginal histograms and Pearson's r.

title: Pairs plot with correlations
summary: Scatter matrix of four regional growth variables, with group KDEs on the diagonal and pooled vs within-group correlations above it.

title: Correlogram with clustering
summary: Corrplot-style circles sized and coloured by r for 12 development indicators, ordered by hierarchical clustering.

title: Coefficient plot
summary: Regression estimates with 95% confidence intervals, one row per term.

title: Odds-ratio forest plot
summary: Logistic regression odds ratios on a log scale, with a table of OR [95% CI] alongside.

title: Comparing nested models
summary: Coefficients of three nested FDI regressions side by side, to see how estimates shift as an EU block is added.

title: Predicted probabilities
summary: Model-based probability curves with 95% CI ribbons across a predictor, by group.

title: Interaction effects
summary: Simple slopes at mean ± 1 SD and a Johnson–Neyman plot for capital inflows and credit growth, moderated by exchange-rate flexibility.

title: Quantile regression process
summary: How a slope changes across the conditional distribution, against the single OLS estimate.

title: Residual diagnostics
summary: The classic 2 × 2 panel for a linear model — linearity, normality, variance, leverage.

title: Influence plot
summary: Studentized residuals vs leverage, with bubbles sized by Cook's distance.

title: ROC curves
summary: Three classifiers compared by ROC curve, AUC with bootstrap 95% CI and Youden point.

title: Calibration plot
summary: Predicted vs observed risk per decile, with Wilson CIs, prediction histograms and Brier score.

title: Added-variable plots
summary: One partial-regression panel per predictor; each fitted slope equals its coefficient.

title: Kaplan–Meier curves
summary: Time from patent filing to grant, domestic vs foreign applicants, with log-rank test and risk table.

title: Cox hazard ratios
summary: Forest plot of a Cox model of time to patent grant, with HR, 95% CI and p-values.

title: Cumulative hazard
summary: Nelson–Aalen cumulative hazard of a drug's launch, with 95% bands, in four market groups.

title: Adjusted survival curves
summary: Cox-predicted time to patent grant at four levels of relatedness, other covariates at their mean.

title: STL decomposition
summary: Monthly manufacturing sales split into trend, seasonal and remainder components.

title: ACF and PACF
summary: ACF and PACF of a monthly sovereign bond spread over the Bund, with 95% significance bands.

title: SARIMA forecast
summary: Seasonal ARIMA forecast of monthly manufacturing sales, with 80% and 95% intervals vs held-out data.

title: Seasonal subseries plot
summary: Each calendar month's manufacturing sales across the years, with the monthly mean.

title: PCA biplot
summary: European countries on institutional and economic indicators, Western Balkans highlighted.

title: Scree plot
summary: How many dimensions describe digital skills in 300 occupations? Variance per component and a parallel-analysis cut-off.

title: Silhouette plot for k-means
summary: Do industries fall into clusters of growth co-movement? k-means clusters next to their silhouette widths.

title: Clustered heatmap
summary: Jaccard similarity between 24 party manifestos, with dendrograms and party-family colour bars.

title: Bootstrap distribution
summary: Online sellers and price dispersion across 20 products — resampled correlation with percentile and BCa 95% CIs.

title: What a 95% confidence interval means
summary: 100 surveys of 30 firms out of 2,000; the 95% CIs for the mean climate-risk score that miss are in red.

title: Power curve
summary: Power of a two-sample t-test against sample size for small, medium and large effects.

title: Bland–Altman plot
summary: Do AI-assisted and expert scores of IPCC scenario passages agree? Bias and 95% limits of agreement.

title: Meta-analysis forest plot
summary: Do teacher expectations raise pupils' IQ? 19 "Pygmalion" experiments, a random-effects pooled diamond and heterogeneity statistics.

title: Funnel plot
summary: Are small "Pygmalion" studies more optimistic? 19 teacher-expectancy effects against their standard error, with a pseudo 95% funnel and Egger's test.
